_provenance.upstream_operation: sigVer (dedicated SigVer vectors with upstream testPassed + reason)
_provenance.local_operation: SigVer via PKCS#11 C_VerifyInit/C_Verify with CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT (upstream context): CKM_SLH_DSA for pure groups, CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> for preHash groups. Positive cases must return CKR_OK; modified-content negatives CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID; too-small/too-large signatures CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE (PKCS#11 v3.2 section 5.1.6: the signature is invalid solely on the basis of its length)
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic, size-budgeted (SLH-DSA signatures are 7.8-49.8 KB). Executed parameter sets per family: 128s, 128f, 192s, 256s (every family x security level; the 128 level in both variants). For each executed set: external/pure group -> one upstream negative case for the reason assigned by rotation over [modified message, modified signature - R, modified signature - SIGFORS, modified signature - SIGHT, invalid signature - too small, invalid signature - too large] (set j of the 8, SHA2 then SHAKE, takes reason j mod 6, so all six reasons are covered), the shortest message for that reason, ties by lowest tcId; plus, for 128s only, the pure positive case with the shortest message. external/preHash group (128s, 128f and 192s only; 256s preHash is subset-size-budget) -> the positive case with the shortest message among hashAlg values that have a PKCS#11 v3.2 CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA_<hash> mechanism (if every positive uses a hash without a mechanism, the shortest-message case with a mechanism, whatever its disposition). Not byte-copied, listed in notExecuted as metadata: the 192f and 256f groups and the 256s preHash group (subset-size-budget: their pure positives are covered as sigGen-derived tuples in slhdsa_ctx_test.json, deterministic byte-match and product-authored negatives run for all 12 sets), preHash cases whose hashAlg has no mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256), and the internal-interface groups. One file per family. Update 2026-10-22: the 6 upstream group(s) formerly listed in notExecuted as no-pkcs11-internal-interface now run from slhdsa_sigver_internal_test.json, through optional test inputs this HSM accepts outside the PKCS#11 standard (caller-supplied random value; internal message encoding for SLH-DSA; the standard CKM_ML_DSA_EXTERNAL_MU for ML-DSA internal). Update 2026-10-22: the 6 upstream case(s) tg8/tc100, tg8/tc111, tg26/tc351, tg26/tc364, tg28/tc383, tg28/tc387 formerly listed in notExecuted are byte-copied into this file by scripts/acvp/copy_upstream_cases.py. PKCS#11 v3.2 has no hash-specific mechanism for SHA2-512/224 or SHA2-512/256; these cases run through the generic CKM_HASH_ML_DSA / CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA with hash = CKM_SHA512_224 or CKM_SHA512_256 and PH(M) supplied, which both engines accept since the engines-5 release.
